name: XrmFrameworkDeployWebresources
author: Dimsi
helpMarkDown:
Deploys through the **XrmFramework CLI** when the job installed it - add the *XrmFramework CLI installer* task before this one - and falls back to the scaffolded **deploy project executable** otherwise.

Only the CLI route can authenticate through *Workload Identity federation*: the task obtains an OIDC token for the service connection, which only a task consuming it can do, and the deployment exchanges it for a Dataverse token. The executable route reads `Config/connectionStrings.config`, as before.

inputs.name: authenticationType
inputs.label: Authentication type
inputs.helpMarkDown: Authentication via username/password is simpler to set up but won't work if your AAD tenant requires MFA; use Service Principal Name (SPN) if MFA is required.

inputs.name: PowerPlatformEnvironment
inputs.label: Service connection
inputs.helpMarkDown: Authenticate with your Power Platform environment with username/password. Does not support MFA.

inputs.name: PowerPlatformSPN
inputs.label: Service connection
inputs.helpMarkDown: Authenticate with your Power Platform environment with an Azure AppID, tenantID and client secret.

inputs.name: Environment
inputs.label: Environment
inputs.helpMarkDown: Environment URL this task targets; default is the pipeline variable that e.g. the CreateEnvironment task has set before.

inputs.name: WebresourcesProjectPath
inputs.label: WebresourcesProjectPath
inputs.helpMarkDown: Path to the Webresources project to deploy

inputs.name: DeployProjectPath
inputs.label: DeployProjectPath
inputs.helpMarkDown: Path to the deploy folder executable

inputs.name: DeployedResourcesPattern
inputs.label: DeployedResourcesPattern
inputs.helpMarkDown: Pattern that will help select the files to deploy

inputs.name: Project
inputs.label: Project
inputs.helpMarkDown: CLI route. Project name as declared under `<projects>` in `xrmFramework.config`. Defaults to the last folder of the project path above.

inputs.name: ExtraArguments
inputs.label: Extra arguments
inputs.helpMarkDown: CLI route. Appended to the command line verbatim, for an option this task does not surface.
